result.summary: The layout, typography and spacing are generally clean and consistent. The clearest visual defect is an implausible '-100%' discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card, which reads as broken data. There is also a small inconsistency in how the favorite (heart) buttons are rendered across cards. Horizontal clipping of the carousel/chips and the card cut off at the bottom were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The badge on the pizza card in 'Popular right now' reads '−100%', implying the item is entirely free. This looks like a data/formatting bug (e.g., a percentage computed or sign-flipped incorrectly) and undermines trust in the promotions shown.
issues.suggestion: Validate discount values before rendering (clamp to a sensible range such as 5–90%) and verify the sign/format logic. If a full free-item offer is intended, use explicit wording like 'Free item' or '100% off' rather than a bare '−100%' chip.

issues.description: The favorite/heart control is styled inconsistently between cards: on the ramen card the heart sits on the dark image with no visible circular backdrop, while on the pizza card it has a distinct dark translucent circle. This makes the same control look like two different components.
issues.suggestion: Apply one shared style for the favorite button (same translucent scrim circle, size, padding and icon stroke) on every card so it stays legible and consistent over any image.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' cards use very different image treatments (the first tile is a pale, low-contrast illustration on light gray while the others are dark photographic-style images), making the row look visually uneven and the white time pill on the light tile nearly blends into the background.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card imagery (consistent background tone/crop or a subtle overlay) and give the delivery-time pill a slight shadow or border so it separates clearly from light images.
